about.title: About me
paragraphs: My name is Bernardo Alencar. I work at Solitu - a creative agency, helping brands build a consistent visual presence and digital experiences that make sense for the people who use them.

My journey started in graphic design, but the drive to understand how things work under the hood led me to the Systems Analysis and Development program — where I study logic, web development and software engineering.

I have experience with visual identities, UI/UX, social media management and institutional communication. On the technical side, I've been deepening my knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, SQL and Java.
More than delivering projects, I like to understand the problem before proposing a solution. Most of what I do starts from collaboration — and that's something I value a lot.

items.description: I'm part of the trainee program at Loopis Jr, the IT junior enterprise of IFPB Campus Cajazeiras. In the commercial area, the work involves prospecting, client relationships and support in preparing proposals. It's an opportunity to learn about sales and management in a real business environment.

items.description: Technical program integrated with high school. It started remotely, at the tail end of the pandemic, which demanded organization and adaptation from day one. Over the three years, I took part in scientific and cultural projects, became vice class-leader and was recognized with top-performance certificates. It was also where I started working with graphic design and first understood what a well-built visual identity is able to communicate.
